Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
More food for you alternate-format types:

I'll be holding a short (non-sanctioned) tournament at Gen*Con this year.
Actually, I'll hold as many as I can, with 9 players per.

V:TES Rapid Thought
Thursday 7pm - 11pm
Entry fee: $3 + G*C fee
Non-sanctioned tournament.
3-player tables.
9 players per tournament.
45 minutes per round.

Special rules:
40-70 card library.
Banned cards: Minion Tap, Blood Doll, Tribute to the Master.

If there's any interest (to be determined on-site), I'll run a few of
these during the Week of Nightmares as well.
(http://www.vtesinla.org/weekofnightmares.htm)

--
LSJ (vte...@white-wolf.com) V:TES Net.Rep for White Wolf, Inc.
Links to revised rulebook, rulings, errata, and tournament rules:
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/
